module.description: Implement a module of a 64-bit ripple carry adder, which includes several 16-bit registers to enable the 16-bit pipeline stages. The output result is available on the result port, and the o_en = 1 indicates the availability of the result.

ports.output: 65-bit output representing the sum of adda and addb.

module.implementation: The module includes several 16-bit registers to enable the 4 pipeline stages and synchronize the input enable signal (i_en). These 16-bit registers are controlled by the clock (clk) and reset (rst_n) signals. The 17-bit sum values for each pipeline stage are calculated by adding the a 16-bit subsection of corresponding input operands and carry signals. The output enable signal (o_en) is updated based on the pipeline stages and synchronized with the clock (clk) and reset (rst_n) signals. When the (result) and the (o_en) must be asserted in the same time, at the same clock (clk) cycle.
